_comment: Machine-readable manifest for the 13 id_map overlay stacks. Generated 2026-05-15 from `drive/Описание лонгрида - порядок слоев.csv`. Each set pairs a default base composition (1 or 3) with an ordered list of overlay layers; `id_layer_click = 1` rows are mandatory (always rendered), all others default ON and can be toggled by the user. Per-row `base_id` on the Sheet/fallback overrides `default_base` (used to disambiguate id_map=1's chapter-1 vs chapter-2 appearance). Vector styles ported from `drive/Стили/*.qml` where present; placeholders are tagged `placeholder: true`. See README.md in this folder for per-field provenance.

mask.note: Faithful to mask.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill black rgb(0,0,0) @ alpha 0.70, outline_style 'no'. (The previous note claiming a mustard fill rgb(190,207,80) was a mix-up — that color belongs to stage_1.qml, not mask.) 0.70 is an aggressive dim; lower opacity if the masked area reads too dark against the relief.

elements.note: Verified faithful to elements.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill with style 'no' (no fill) + a pale-teal outline rgb(185,219,210) at 0.46 mm (~1.3 px). Outline-only.

vomitoria.note: Faithful to vomitoria.qml <renderer-v2>: a single SimpleLine in vivid blue rgb(29,70,205), 0.66 mm (~1.9 px), solid — no fill. The previous purple fill rgb(141,90,153) was invented.

sector_1.note: Faithful to sector.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill with transparent fill (255,255,255 @ alpha 0) + a black solid outline at 0.1 mm — no fill. Like sectors_level but solid (not dashed). The previous red fill/outline/line was invented.

resettlement.note: Faithful to resettlement.qmd.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill pink rgb(243,78,157), fill style 'dense3' (sparse hatch), outline_style 'no'. MapLibre renders the dense3 density as a solid fill at opacity 0.4. The previous yellow rgb(213,180,60) + outline was invented.

resettlement_after_stage.note: Faithful to resettlement_after_stage.qml <renderer-v2>: categorizedSymbol on `type` (5 land-use classes IND/MF/MU/PKG/SF), all dense3 fill, outline_style 'no'. Rendered as per-category solid fills via fill_categories (dense3 → solid). The previous flat green rgb(114,155,111) was invented.

stage_isolated_urban_areas.note: Faithful to stage_isolated_urban_areas.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill style 'no' (no fill) + a dark dashed outline rgb(35,35,35) at 0.3 mm. The previous purple fill was invented.

stage_barier.note: Faithful to stage_barier.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill style 'no' (no fill) + a dark dashed outline rgb(35,35,35) at 0.3 mm. Same renderer as stage_isolated_urban_areas. The previous purple fill was invented.

stage_1.note: Faithful to stage_1.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill with fill style 'no' (the mustard rgb(190,207,80) color is set but not rendered, since style='no') + a solid dark outline rgb(35,35,35) at 0.46 mm (~1.3 px). Outline-only. Distinct from base composition #1's `stage`. The previous purple fill was invented.

historical_resettlement.note: Verified faithful to historical_resettlement.qml <renderer-v2>: SimpleFill vivid orange rgb(218,89,12), fill style 'dense3', outline_style 'no'. dense3 rendered as a solid fill at opacity 0.4. No outline/line (the previous line was invented).

slope.note: No QML on disk; muted olive distinguishes from search_bound (red) and resettlement (yellow). Replace when design ships canonical QML.

search_bound_one_step.note: Faithful to search_bound_one_step.qml <renderer-v2>: a single SimpleLine, black rgb(0,0,0), 0.3 mm (~1.0 px), dashed (use_custom_dash=1, customdash 2;1 → [2,1]). No fill. The previous red fill/outline was invented.

search_bound.note: Faithful to search_bound.qml <renderer-v2>: a single SimpleLine, black rgb(0,0,0), 0.5 mm (~1.4 px), solid. No fill. The previous red fill/outline was invented.

amphitheater_bound_1.note: Verified faithful to amphitheater_bound_1.qml <renderer-v2>: solid dark-charcoal SimpleLine rgb(67,69,69) at 0.9 mm (~2.5 px). Thicker variant of base composition #1's `amphitheater_bound` (0.5 mm). Not dashed.

landscape_450.note: Verified: landscape_450.qml <renderer-v2> is categorizedSymbol on `Ландшафт` (Ижорское плато / Путиловское плато) but BOTH categories share the same peach base rgb(244,154,90) with dense5/dense6 hatch — so a single flat fill is faithful (no per-category difference). Hatch approximated as solid @ 0.4. No outline (QML uses sub-pixel dot).

landscape_2,5.note: Verified: landscape_2,5.qml <renderer-v2> is categorizedSymbol on `Ландшафт` (Дудергофские высоты rgb(202,207,90) / Моренный пояс rgb(191,195,92)) — near-identical olives with dense6 hatch. Kept as a single flat olive fill (difference is imperceptible). Hatch approximated as solid @ 0.4. No outline.

landscape_12.note: Faithful to landscape_12.qml <renderer-v2>: categorizedSymbol on `Ландшафт` (5 categories with diagonal_x/cross/dense7/solid hatch over a pale base). Rendered as per-category solid fills using the saturated hatch color as representative. The previous flat rgb(231,113,72) + outline was invented.

landscape_7.note: Faithful to landscape_7.qml <renderer-v2>: categorizedSymbol on `Ландшафт` (5 categories; mix of PointPatternFill / hatch / solid). Rendered as per-category solid fills. The previous flat purple rgb(141,90,153) appears nowhere in the QML palette.

calibration_note: QML widths are in mm; MapLibre line-width is in px. QML's 0.6 mm line (≈1.7 px) and 0.2 mm outline (≈0.57 px) are used as-is for `line` and bumped to 1.0 px for outlines (matches base composition #1's calibration). Fill opacities are calibrated downward to 0.3–0.4 (from QML's 1.0) so overlays read against the relief base; tune per-style as needed.
